title: How do I update the mobile number registered on my account?
content:
Question: How do I update the mobile number registered on my account?

Answer: Log in to the My NovaTel app or self-care portal, go to Profile > Contact Details, and select 'Update Alternate Number'. You will need to verify via OTP sent to your existing registered number. If you no longer have access to it, visit a NovaTel Experience Store with valid photo ID.

Topic: Account Management
